fact_refresh_unbound.description: A scheduling-layer selection document read a realistic instance fact key (fact_key, a resource. or inventory. key that recognition writes) for a candidate on the instance, and the value is unknown (unknown_reason), but no reader can refresh it (reader_problem, when known). Only that candidate is deferred, with no wake; it is evaluated again when the instance facts, the catalog or the configuration change. Other candidates and instances are unaffected.
fact_refresh_unbound.common_causes: The instance has never had the fact read, or its record expired, went stale for the document, lost confidence or has another type; the instance has no recognition maintenance package bound, or that package does not mark the key.
fact_refresh_unbound.handling: Run a task that reads the fact on that instance, or bind a recognition maintenance package that marks the key; the candidate is reconsidered once the fact is published.

selection_evaluation_aborted.description: Retired. A scheduling-layer selection document met an unknown input under an abort_evaluation clause, and the whole scheduling evaluation failed for every instance. Since 0.12.0 the scheduling layer defers only the candidate that read the input (fact_refresh_unbound or selection_input_unknown) and the round goes on.
selection_evaluation_aborted.common_causes: An instance fact the document reads was missing or expired on one instance while the document declared abort_evaluation for it.
selection_evaluation_aborted.handling: None in 0.12.0 and later: the code is no longer emitted. Before 0.12.0, refresh the fact or change the clause to drop_candidate.

selection_input_unknown.description: A gate or term (rule_id) of a scheduling-layer selection document met an unknown input (unknown_reason) for a candidate on the instance that no reading can supply: an instruction key or pack data no instruction supplied, a fixed field, or a lookup that covers no value. Only that candidate is deferred, with no wake; it is evaluated again when the instance facts or the catalog change. One entry is written per rule that met such an input.
selection_input_unknown.common_causes: An instruction key (session.) was never set for the instance; the document's lookup lacks an entry and a default for a value the candidate has; the document reads a field the candidate does not carry.
selection_input_unknown.handling: Supply the instruction for the instance, or fix the selection document (add the lookup entry or default, or read a field the scheduling layer provides) and approve the catalog again.

selection_unknown_clause_ignored.description: A gate or term (rule_id) of a scheduling-layer selection document declares a drop_candidate or substitute clause (unknown_clause) that the scheduling layer does not apply: there an unknown input defers the candidate that read it. The document's author meant something else than what runs. An abort_evaluation clause gives no warning.
selection_unknown_clause_ignored.common_causes: A selection document written for an in-task select step, where the clauses apply, is used as the scheduling-layer document.
selection_unknown_clause_ignored.handling: Expect the candidate to be deferred instead of dropped or scored with the substitute; to keep the clause's effect, use the document in a select step instead.

feature_locked.description: A candidate is deferred because the active, unexpired session.feature. record fact_key of its instance is false and the task needs that feature; next_eligible_unix_ms is the record's expiry when it has one. A missing or expired record never defers (there is no substitute value).
feature_locked.common_causes: A run met the feature's locked page earlier; a person or an agent marked the feature locked.
feature_locked.handling: Nothing to repair. Publish true for the key once the feature is unlocked; otherwise the task is tried again when the record expires.

decision_reason_missing.description: A decision that is not selected ended without a reason, which is a programming error in the evaluator. The candidate is still deferred and the evaluation round goes on, so the gap is visible rather than reported as none.
decision_reason_missing.common_causes: An evaluator path that defers or blocks a candidate without pushing its reason.
decision_reason_missing.handling: Report it with the evaluation's inputs; the evaluator path needs its reason.

pack_schedule_closed.description: Every candidate of the task package package_id is deferred because the pack schedule that applies to the instance (an instruction row of session.pack.schedule, else a default row of the standard package) says the package is not schedulable now; next_eligible_unix_ms is the end of the covering row.
pack_schedule_closed.common_causes: A person or an agent closed the package for a period; the standard package closes it by default.
pack_schedule_closed.handling: Nothing to repair. Write a row that makes the package schedulable, or wait for the row to end.

pack_schedule_unknown_package.description: A session.pack.schedule row names a package that no task of the active catalog uses. Reported once per evaluation cycle; the row is kept and has no effect until a catalog uses the package. Not an error.
pack_schedule_unknown_package.common_causes: A row written for a package of another standard package or catalog generation.
pack_schedule_unknown_package.handling: Nothing to repair; remove the row if it is no longer wanted.
